connector.name: Agent Sniper
connector.registryDescription: Self-custodial pump.fun sniper: arm strategies, snipe, manage positions. Simulate by default.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-sniper. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SNIPER_MODE
env.description: Trade mode: simulate | live. simulate scores, guards, and logs every decision but NEVER broadcasts. live signs and broadcasts real transactions with real funds. Defaults to simulate — keep it there until your strategy is verified.

env.name: SNIPER_NETWORK
env.description: Solana cluster to trade on: mainnet | devnet. Defaults to mainnet.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Solana RPC endpoint. A public RPC rate-limits under the new-mint firehose, so live mode refuses to start without this set. Optional in simulate mode.

env.name: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Default self-custody wallet secret for single-agent runs — base58, a JSON byte array, or 0x-hex. Stays on your machine; the engine signs locally. Required only for live trading. Treat it like a password.
